name: Prior-authorization follow-up list
summary: Each morning the referral coordinator gets one list from the practice’s own spreadsheet: which authorization requests to chase today, which procedures are booked without an approval, what the payer is waiting on, and what the list is missing. A person makes every call.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI’s own worked illustration of a referral desk’s authorization follow-up procedure, built for an invented medical practice.
